title: Keen Dreams
subtitle: id Software / Softdisk, 1991 · Borland C++ 2.0, MODEL MEDIUM, three TASM modules · 16-bit real mode, EGA

needsData.hint: the shareware 1.13 data (KDREAMS.EGA, KDREAMS.MAP, KDREAMS.AUD, ...) with the static/ headers tools/keen-static.mjs extracts from its own KDREAMS.EXE

_data: The 1.93 source's own static/MAPHEAD.KDR and MAPDICT.KDR do not describe the 1.13 maps (docs/COMPAT.md). A data directory that carries static/ -- written by tools/keen-static.mjs from the data set's own KDREAMS.EXE -- supplies the two that match, and the page takes a data object from the player's files before the source tree's.
